label: Attachment/Blob (Sync Gateway)
type: binary data (e.g. images, files) associated with a Sync Gateway document, managed exclusively through Sync Gateway's own REST API endpoints rather than through Couchbase Server SDKs directly. Excluded from sgw:delta-sync's delta computation and from replica-database delta sync entirely.
evidence: You should note that delta sync does not apply to attachment contents and that it is disabled for Couchbase Lite database replicas.
note: Minted in delta-sync.json (the exclusion-from-delta-computation fact) and reused in sync-with-couchbase-server.json ('Use Sync Gateway's REST API's /{db}/{docid}/{attachment} endpoints to manage attachments and blob data; you cannot use Couchbase Server SDKs to do this directly' - filed as mustUseInsteadWhen). No existing registry concept for Couchbase Mobile attachments/blobs before this round.
